title: ChatAnalysisOutput
description: Structured JSON contract for ChatAnalysisProvider.analyze() output. Locked by G3-T02 (2026-08-02). Single source of truth for both backend and frontend — see docs/schemas/chat_analysis_v1.dictionary.md for human-readable documentation. Mirrors the Java enum taxonomy in com.mindbridge.analysis.provider (Topic, Emotion, Intent, Signal) and the ChatAnalysisOutput record. Risk levels and confidence ranges follow docs/04 §3 (Risk Levels) and §7 (LLM Safety Classification). Evidence spans use SHA-256 hex digests (no raw text) per docs/04 §5 'Evidence phải gắn với source' and rule 30 'Do not log unnecessary raw prompts or raw responses containing sensitive data'.

topic.description: Dominant subject the user is talking about. See Topic enum (backend) and dictionary.md. NOT a clinical label.

emotion.description: Dominant emotional tone observed in the message. DISTRESS is safety-relevant. Anti-diagnosis guard: this is a tone label, not a clinical state.

intent.description: What the user appears to want from the chat. The chat consumer uses this to pick a tone — NOT a final action decision (Safety Resolver and matching pipeline remain authoritative).

signals.description: Behaviour-level tags attached to the message. May be empty. SELF_HARM_RISK and HOPELESSNESS are safety-relevant — Safety Resolver consumes them as part of max-wins.

modelRiskLevel.description: Model's own risk signal (1=normal, 2=follow-up, 3=high risk, 4=emergency). NOT the final risk level — Safety Resolver (G3-T10) combines this with keyword/regex pre-filter and the user's current risk state.

confidence.description: Self-reported confidence in the model output, unit interval [0.0, 1.0]. Coarse signal, not a calibrated probability (rule 30 + docs/04 §7).

start.description: Inclusive start offset in characters into the input message (same convention as String.substring).

end.description: Exclusive end offset in characters into the input message. Must be > start.

textHash.description: SHA-256 hex digest (lowercase, 64 hex chars) of the substring [start, end). NEVER the raw substring — see EvidenceSpan JavaDoc and rule 30 'Do not log unnecessary raw prompts or raw responses'.

evidenceSpans.description: Pointers into the input message that justify the output. May be empty for short or generic messages. Use textHash to verify the substring offline without storing sensitive text.

latencyMs.description: Wall-clock time the provider spent producing the result, in milliseconds. The provider tracks actual latency; the model MUST emit 0 (see chat_analysis_prompt_v1.md §64).

errorCode.description: Stable code for partial / failed outputs (e.g. MALFORMED_JSON). null for successful outputs. Never raw error text.

schemaVersion.description: Schema version of this record. Always V1 in this revision. See AnalysisSchemaVersion JavaDoc for the versioning policy.
